name: Reevaluate archetype after incentive change
structure: Separate competitive motivation from whether a list remains effective after award or format changes.
acceptance: Use dated evidence, not sentiment as proof.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Respect-induced change in target value
structure: When rivals avoid a known early answer, compare alternatives against their revised development.
acceptance: No assumption every opponent adapts identically.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Recovery slot under wide-board pressure
structure: Retain a late option that may rebuild or convert score after removal.
acceptance: Check actual cost, timing, opposing restrictions and viable clock.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Local field interaction selection
structure: Choose answer coverage from expected threats and alternative use.
acceptance: Test actual lists, no universal preference.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Outcome and matchup attribution
structure: Separate event result, plausible cause and claimed sole out.
acceptance: No certainty of hidden deck or only-out claim without full state.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Repeated list experimentation
structure: Change a limited slot package and log baseline, conditions and results.
acceptance: Changing lists confounds pooled comparison; no causal inference.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Domain-dependent answer avoidance
structure: Rival can route modifiers to different legal recipients to reduce answer utility.
acceptance: Verify exact recipient eligibility and alternative costs.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Reinforce disposable pressure
structure: Compare adding temporary strength to available body with deploying new one.
acceptance: Verify exact modifiers, duration and card access.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Countering reusable effect
structure: Evaluate immediate disruption despite possible later reuse.
acceptance: Verify Flow, counter and zone rules; no automatic replay.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Narrow answer with multiple roles
structure: Compare domain-specific answer across gear, engines and bodies if eligible.
acceptance: Verify targets and effects; not universal removal.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Token conversion versus hold
structure: Compare exchanging small body for larger threat with preserving its scoring pressure.
acceptance: Include rival removal and score clock.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Engine-first disruption
structure: Prioritize repeatable payoff enabler over expendable residual bodies.
acceptance: Do not ignore imminent scoring or alternative engine.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Public copy ledger
structure: Track visibly spent movement and response cards to bound remaining possibilities.
acceptance: Unknown deck counts, reuse and later draws prevent certainty.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Base interaction as setup denial
structure: Compare removing an enabler before payoff versus later removal.
acceptance: Verify actual timing and target eligibility.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Compensated removal
structure: Accept rival card compensation when interruption prevents a more valuable route.
acceptance: Rival may use those cards; account for time and access.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Threat sequencing to consume mobility
structure: Use credible pressure to make opposing movement resources valuable to spend before engine removal.
acceptance: Opponent can decline or move elsewhere; not forced exhaustion.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Matchup-dependent field and opener
structure: Match starting-order field and opening roles to opposing clock and dependencies.
acceptance: Verify field selection and actual mulligan rules.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Gear and unit answer ordering
structure: Compare removing a disposable support asset before narrow removal.
acceptance: Verify target and resolution sequence.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Counter bait with alternate payoff
structure: A first credible threat may draw response and leave another line available.
acceptance: Model answer and ignore branches and other legal responses.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Multi-action threshold audit
structure: Check all resources and windows for proposed removal-counter-removal-payoff sequence.
acceptance: Nine-rune source sequence is unverified; no invented successful trace.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Pressure as information acquisition
structure: Use actual rival responses to update hypotheses about remaining options.
acceptance: Nonresponse is ambiguous, no certainty of hidden hand.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.

name: Specialist identity under revision
structure: Show a competitor balancing familiarity, results, local field and future preparation.
acceptance: Independent character motives, no copied anecdotes or biography.
novelty: Overlapping candidate refinement, not independent discovery.
